append.detail: Built 2026-11-16: lib/hunts/analytics.ts is the Hunt event registry (placement scan, stop claim, staff verify, reward redeem, reward void), each also registered server-only in lib/analytics/events.ts. Four closed dimensions (reason class, medium, cohort, assurance) plus the Hunt id and replayed are the whole allowlist: a property is kept only when its name is listed and its value passes a closed set, a uuid or a boolean check, so a location, code, venue, stop key, token or contact cannot pass by any spelling. Forwarding to Google: a guest only when HUNTS_GUEST_ANALYTICS_ENABLED is on (new switch, blank by default, gate in docs/RUNBOOKS.md), a member only with their recorded analytics consent (consent_records, lib/consent/consent.ts), staff never and with no actor written. Hooked after the response at the scan landing and claim POST (app/(main)/hunts/p/[code]/route.ts), the typed-code claim (play/actions.ts), the staff door and the redemption station. A failed write logs only the allowlisted fields. Proof: lib/hunts/analytics.test.ts (hostile payloads, default-off guest forwarding, consent, log line). Not done by an agent: FH-023 (privacy sign-off) still gates turning guest forwarding on.
